exposure: Category II fetal heart rate tracings
cohort: Theoretical cohort of 900,000 women undergoing labor induction at term in the United States
finding: Decreasing or stopping oxytocin in response to Category II fetal heart rate tracings was found to be cost-effective, despite increasing the rate of cesarean deliveries.
mod_finding: Decreasing or stopping oxytocin in response to Category II fetal heart rate tracings increased the rate of cesarean deliveries.
